description: A dim, painted interior of a tiled room with a white padded gurney as the central object. Thick brown leather straps hang from its arms, legs and torso, and a metal IV stand with coiled tubing stands behind it. A barred window sits in the upper left with a faint shadowy figure behind the bars. The walls are grey-green tile, stained and dirty, and the floor is dark. The style is loose oil painting, with no visible text, frame or wall-hung canvas.
